base.description: Base path for style files, in case it's piped to STDIN or for relative resolution.

zoom.description: Target zoom level for the map tile.

ppi.description: Pixels per inch (resolution) for the output image.

size_px.description: Target dimensions in pixels. Can contain one 0 for auto-calculation.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates: xmin ymin xmax ymax in degrees.

paper.description: Paper format for output (e.g., A4, letter, +4, -4).

fmt.description: Target file format (e.g., png, jpg). Defaults to extension.

layers.description: Map layers to render. Comma-separated list in CLI, space-separated here for template expansion.

add_layers.description: Map layers to include in addition to default.

vars.description: List of variables (name=value) to substitute in the style file.

fonts.description: List of full paths to directories containing fonts.

style.description: Path to the Mapnik style file.
